executive_summary_zh: 今天候选源很弱，只有一条值得关注的高信号更新：GitHub Copilot SDK 开始支持面向 GitHub App 的 server-to-server 认证。
这不是模型能力新闻，而是企业把 AI coding agent 从“绑在人身上的工具”推进到“可审计、可计费、可治理的组织级工作负载身份”的基础设施变化。
对平台工程和开发者体验团队而言，重点在于：组织级计费归属、短期 token、权限边界、审计字段，以及让自动化 agent 不再依赖个人登录态。
executive_summary_en: The candidate set is weak today, with only one clearly high-signal item: GitHub Copilot SDK now supports server-to-server authentication for GitHub Apps.
This is not a model-news story; it is an infrastructure change that moves AI coding agents from user-bound tools toward auditable, billable, governable organization-owned workloads.

For platform and developer-experience teams, the key points are org-level attribution, short-lived tokens, permission boundaries, auditability, and removing dependency on individual user sessions for automation.

items.title: GitHub Copilot supports server-to-server authentication
items.summary_zh: GitHub Copilot SDK 现支持 GitHub App 的 server-to-server 认证（公测）。组织安装后的 GitHub App 可使用短期 installation access token 代表组织调用 Copilot，而无需依赖某个已登录用户的凭证。相关用量归属到安装该 App 的组织，并自动受组织模型策略、预算和花费控制约束；管理员也可查看哪些 App 有权限，并在 AI usage CSV 中通过 app_client_id 识别其使用情况。
items.summary_en: GitHub Copilot SDK now supports server-to-server authentication for GitHub Apps in public preview. An org-installed GitHub App can use a short-lived installation access token to call Copilot on behalf of the organization, without depending on an individual signed-in user. Usage is attributed to the owning organization and inherits org-level model policies, budgets, and spend controls; admins can also review app access and identify app-attributed usage via app_client_id in AI usage CSV reports.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是企业级 AI coding agent 落地的关键缺口补齐。过去很多自动化 Copilot 集成受限于“用户身份借给服务用”，在稳定性、离职风险、审计、计费归属与最小权限上都不理想。现在可把 agent 作为组织拥有的工作负载来运营，为后台服务、CI/CD 机器人、代码治理代理、批量代码变更流水线提供更稳健的身份模型。
items.why_it_matters_en: This closes an important enterprise gap for production AI coding agents. Many Copilot automations previously had to rely on user-linked credentials, which is fragile for reliability, offboarding, auditability, billing attribution, and least-privilege design. With workload-owned identity, teams can operate backend services, CI/CD bots, code-governance agents, and bulk-change pipelines as organization-owned agents instead of user-bound automations.
key_takeaways_zh: 身份模型从“用户代理”转向“工作负载代理”：GitHub App + 短期 installation token 成为更合理的 agent 身份基础。
治理能力更完整：权限可单独授予 read-only Copilot Requests，计费和用量归属组织，并受预算、策略、支出控制和报表审计覆盖。
key_takeaways_en: The identity model shifts from user-bound automation to workload-owned agents: GitHub Apps plus short-lived installation tokens become the right foundation for service-side Copilot usage.
Governance is materially stronger: a dedicated read-only Copilot Requests permission, org-level attribution and billing, and coverage by budgets, policies, spend controls, and reporting.

new_terms_zh: server-to-server authentication：服务到服务认证，使组织安装的 GitHub App 可不依赖个人登录态调用 Copilot。
workload-owned identity：工作负载拥有身份，指 agent/服务以组织控制的应用身份而非员工个人身份运行。
installation access token：GitHub App 安装级短期访问令牌，用于代表某个组织安装实例访问授权资源。
app_client_id：在 AI usage CSV 报表中标识具体应用客户端的字段，用于审计和成本归因。
new_terms_en: server-to-server authentication: a service-to-service auth model that lets an org-installed GitHub App call Copilot without a human sign-in session.
workload-owned identity: an identity pattern where the agent/service runs under an organization-controlled app identity rather than an individual employee identity.
installation access token: a short-lived token issued for a GitHub App installation, used to access resources on behalf of that installation.
app_client_id: a field in AI usage CSV reports used to identify the calling app client for audit and cost attribution.
themes_zh: AI coding 从个人助手走向组织级自动化基础设施
Agent 身份、权限、成本归因与审计成为企业落地关键
GitHub 正在把 Copilot 接入企业平台治理模型而非仅做 IDE 内功能
themes_en: AI coding is moving from personal assistance toward organization-level automation infrastructure
Agent identity, permissions, cost attribution, and auditability are becoming core enterprise adoption requirements
GitHub is integrating Copilot into enterprise platform-governance models, not just shipping IDE features
implications_zh: 如果你在做内部编码代理、代码修改机器人或大规模迁移工具，应评估把用户 OAuth/个人 PAT 流程迁移到 GitHub App 身份。
平台团队需要补上配套能力：App 生命周期管理、最小权限模板、token 轮换、用量归因、预算告警和停用流程。
这类能力一旦成熟，组织会更容易批准“无人值守”的代码生成/修改工作流进入生产环境。
implications_en: If you operate internal coding agents, change bots, or large-scale migration tooling, you should evaluate migrating from user OAuth/personal-token flows to GitHub App identities.
Platform teams will need supporting controls: app lifecycle management, least-privilege templates, token rotation, usage attribution, budget alerts, and kill-switch processes.
As this capability matures, organizations will be more willing to approve unattended code-generation and code-modification workflows in production environments.
what_to_ignore_zh: GitHub Changelog 首页与月度归档页只是聚合页，不应当作独立高信号条目。
不要把这条更新误读成模型能力提升；它的价值主要在身份、治理、审计与组织采用，而非生成质量。
what_to_ignore_en: Ignore the GitHub Changelog homepage and monthly archive page; they are just index pages, not distinct high-signal items.
Do not misread this as a model-capability improvement; the value is in identity, governance, auditability, and organizational adoption rather than output quality.
